title: Exhaustive Adam2Jesus Biblical Expansion (Judges, House of Saul, All 20 Kings of Judah, All 19 Kings of Israel, High Priests, Prophets, Esther, Job, Dual Line to Jesus, Herodians & Foreign Kings)

nodes.name: Seir the Horite → Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer & Dishan
nodes.notes: Original Horite inhabitants of Mount Seir whose daughters (Timna, Oholibamah) intermarried with Esau and Eliphaz, merging Horites and Edomites.

nodes.name: Melchizedek (King & Priest of Salem)
nodes.role: King of Righteousness & Priest of El Elyon
nodes.notes: King of Salem (Jerusalem) who blesses Abraham. Book of Jasher 16:11 & Targums identify him with Shem son of Noah; his name ('King of Righteousness') also echoes Phoenician Sydyk in Sanchuniathon!

nodes.name: Job (Land of Uz) → Jemimah, Keziah & Keren-happuch
nodes.role: Righteous Patriarch of Uz & His 3 Friends + Elihu
nodes.notes: Dwelt in the Land of Uz; comforted/debated by Eliphaz the Temanite (Esau!), Bildad the Shuhite (Shuah/Abraham!), Zophar the Naamathite, and Elihu the Buzite (son of Barachel, from Nahor II's son Buz!).

nodes.name: Joshua (Hoshea son of Nun) & Caleb (son of Jephunneh)
nodes.role: Two Faithful Spies & Leaders Into Canaan
nodes.notes: Joshua (Tribe of Ephraim via Shuthelah -> Elishama -> Nun) succeeds Moses; Caleb the Kenizzite (Tribe of Judah, father of Achsah) conquers Hebron from the Anakim!

nodes.name: Zelophehad's 5 Daughters (Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, Tirzah) & Bezalel
nodes.role: Pioneers of Female Inheritance Law & Tabernacle Architect
nodes.notes: Manasseh -> Makir -> Gilead -> Hepher -> Zelophehad's 5 daughters established landmark inheritance rights in Israel; Judah -> Hezron -> Caleb -> Hur -> Uri -> Bezalel (+ Oholiab of Dan) crafted the Tabernacle & Ark!

nodes.name: Korah (Korahites), Asaph & Heman (Temple Singers)
nodes.notes: Izhar -> Korah -> Assir, Elkanah, Ebiasaph (ancestors of Samuel and the Korahite psalmists!), alongside Gershonite Asaph ('The Seer') and Kohathite Heman.

nodes.name: Arba → Anak (Anakim) → Sheshai, Ahiman, Talmai & Goliath of Gath
nodes.notes: Giants of Hebron (Kiriath-arba) linked in Num 13:33 to the Nephilim; remnants in Philistine Gath produce Goliath (+ brother Lahmi, slain by David & Elhanan).

nodes.name: Beor (of Pethor, Aram) → Balaam the Diviner
nodes.role: Aramean Seer Attested in the Deir Alla Inscription!
nodes.notes: Summoned by Moabite King Balak (son of Zippor) to curse Israel; archaeologically attested in the 8th-c. BCE Deir Alla plaster inscription in Jordan! Book of Jasher 72 also depicts Balaam rebelling in Cush against King Kikanos.

nodes.name: 1. Judge Othniel (son of Kenaz + Achsah)
nodes.notes: First Judge of Israel; nephew/brother of Caleb who marries Caleb's daughter Achsah.

nodes.name: 2. Judge Ehud (son of Gera, Benjamin)
nodes.notes: Left-handed Benjaminite deliverer who slew Moabite King Eglon.

nodes.name: 3. Judge Shamgar (son of Anath)
nodes.notes: Delivered Israel from 600 Philistines with an oxgoad.

nodes.name: 4. Judge Deborah (+ Barak) & Jael (+ Heber the Kenite)
nodes.notes: Prophetess & Judge who led Barak against Canaanite general Sisera; Jael (wife of Heber the Kenite, descendant of Midianite Hobab/Jethro!) slew Sisera.

nodes.name: 5. Judge Gideon (Jerubbaal) → Abimelech & Jotham
nodes.notes: Son of Joash (Abiezrite of Manasseh) who defeated Midian with 300 men; father of 70 sons including Abimelech, Jotham, and Jether.

nodes.name: 6. Judge Tola (Issachar) & 7. Judge Jair (Gilead)
nodes.notes: Tola (Issachar, judged 23 yrs) and Jair of Gilead (Manasseh, 30 sons riding 30 donkeys).

nodes.name: 8. Judge Jephthah (of Gilead)
nodes.notes: Mighty warrior of Gilead who delivered Israel from the Ammonites.

nodes.name: 9. Ibzan (Bethlehem), 10. Elon (Zebulun) & 11. Abdon
nodes.notes: Three minor Judges preceding Samson.

nodes.name: 12. Judge Samson (son of Manoah of Zorah, Dan)
nodes.notes: Nazirite strongman of the Tribe of Dan (+ Delilah) who battled the Philistines.

nodes.name: Judge & High Priest Eli → Hophni, Phinehas, Ichabod & Abiathar
nodes.notes: Descended from Aaron's son Ithamar; priest at Shiloh who mentored Samuel; line continues via Ahitub -> Ahimelech -> High Priest Abiathar under David.

nodes.name: Prophet & Judge Samuel (son of Elkanah & Hannah)
nodes.notes: Kohathite Levite (via Korah -> Elkanah & Hannah); final Judge who anointed BOTH King Saul and King David! Grandfather of Heman the Singer.

nodes.name: Aphiah → Abiel → Kish → King Saul (+ Ahinoam & Rizpah)
nodes.notes: Anointed by Samuel; father of Jonathan, Ish-bosheth (Esh-baal), Malki-shua, Merab, and Michal; uncle Ner fathered General Abner!

nodes.name: Jonathan (→ Mephibosheth), Ish-bosheth, Michal & General Abner
nodes.role: Royal Children & Commander of King Saul
nodes.notes: Jonathan (covenant friend of David; father of Mephibosheth -> Micah -> Eshek -> Ulam!), Michal (wife of David), Ish-bosheth (2nd brief king over northern tribes), and cousin Abner.

nodes.name: Jesse's House: Eliab, Zeruiah (→ Joab, Abishai, Asahel) & Abigail (→ Amasa)
nodes.notes: David's sister Zeruiah bore his three supreme commanders (Joab, Abishai, Asahel); sister Abigail married Jether the Ishmaelite and bore General Amasa!

nodes.name: Ahithophel → Eliam → Bathsheba (+ Uriah the Hittite)
nodes.notes: Bathsheba (daughter of Eliam, granddaughter of counselor Ahithophel) was wed to Uriah the Hittite before marrying King David and bearing Shimea, Shobab, Nathan (Luke 3 line!), and Solomon (Matthew 1 line!).

nodes.name: Hadad the Edomite (+ Sister of Queen Tahpenes of Egypt) → Genubath
nodes.role: Edomite Prince Raised in Pharaoh's Palace
nodes.notes: Fled Edom to Egypt, married the sister of Egyptian Queen Tahpenes (under Pharaoh Shishak/Siamun), and fathered Genubath — an explicit Biblical royal marriage uniting Egypt and Edom!

nodes.name: Rehoboam (1st King of Judah)
nodes.notes: Son of Solomon & Naamah the Ammonitess; invaded by Pharaoh Shishak (Shoshenq I).

nodes.name: Abijah (Abijam)
nodes.notes: Son of Rehoboam & Queen Maacah (granddaughter of Absalom).

nodes.name: Asa (King of Judah)
nodes.notes: Reforming king who defeated Zerah the Cushite.

nodes.name: Jehoshaphat (King of Judah)
nodes.notes: Son of Asa & Azubah; allied with Ahab of Israel.

nodes.name: Jehoram (+ Queen Athaliah)
nodes.notes: Married Athaliah (daughter of Ahab & Jezebel!), uniting the royal houses of Judah, Israel, and Phoenician Sidon!

nodes.name: Ahaziah & Queen Athaliah (Sole Female Monarch of Judah)
nodes.notes: Ahaziah slain by Jehu; Queen Athaliah seized Judah's throne for 6 years until High Priest Jehoiada crowned young Joash.

nodes.name: Joash (Jehoash) → Amaziah
nodes.notes: Hidden in the Temple by Aunt Jehosheba & High Priest Jehoiada; father of Amaziah.

nodes.name: Uzziah (Azariah) → Jotham → Ahaz
nodes.notes: Uzziah (52-yr reign; era of Isaiah's call) -> Jotham -> Ahaz (vassal of Tiglath-Pileser III).

nodes.name: King Hezekiah (+ Hephzibah)
nodes.notes: Withstood Sennacherib's siege of Jerusalem alongside Prophet Isaiah & Cushite Pharaoh Taharqa (Tirhakah)! Ancestor of Prophet Zephaniah.

nodes.name: Manasseh (55 yrs) → Amon
nodes.notes: Longest-reigning king of Judah; vassal of Esarhaddon & Ashurbanipal.

nodes.name: King Josiah (+ Zebidah & Hamutal)
nodes.notes: Great Deuteronomic reformer; fell at Megiddo confronting Pharaoh Neco II of Egypt (609 BCE). Father of Jehoahaz, Jehoiakim, and Zedekiah.

nodes.name: Jehoahaz, Jehoiakim & King Zedekiah (Fall of Jerusalem, 586 BCE)
nodes.notes: Three sons of Josiah who reigned during Babylon's conquest; Zedekiah was final king before Babylonian Exile.

nodes.name: Jehoiachin (Jeconiah) → Shealtiel → Zerubbabel
nodes.notes: Son of Jehoiakim carried to Babylon (attested in Babylonian ration tablets!); grandfather of Zerubbabel, Governor of Yehud under Cyrus & Darius I!

nodes.name: 1. Jeroboam I (son of Nebat, Ephraim) → 2. Nadab
nodes.notes: First King of the Northern Kingdom of Israel (10 tribes); sheltered earlier by Pharaoh Shishak in Egypt.

nodes.name: 3. Baasha → 4. Elah → 5. Zimri
nodes.notes: Second northern dynasty (Issachar) followed by 7-day reign of Zimri.

nodes.name: 6. Omri → 7. King Ahab (+ Queen Jezebel of Sidon!) → 8. Ahaziah & 9. Joram
nodes.notes: House of Omri (attested on the Mesha Stele & Assyrian Kurkh Monolith!). Ahab married Princess Jezebel, daughter of Ethbaal King of Tyre/Sidon — exact same Ethbaal who is great-uncle of Queen Dido of Carthage!

nodes.name: 10. Jehu → 11. Jehoahaz → 12. Jehoash → 13. Jeroboam II → 14. Zechariah
nodes.notes: Jehu (attested bowing on Shalmaneser III's Black Obelisk!) overthrew Omri's house; Jeroboam II led northern Israel's peak prosperity.

nodes.name: 15. Shallum → 16. Menahem → 17. Pekahiah → 18. Pekah → 19. Hoshea (722 BCE)
nodes.notes: Final kings of Northern Israel before Samaria fell to Assyria (Shalmaneser V / Sargon II, 722 BCE — Assyrian Exile!).

nodes.name: Eleazar → Phinehas → Abishua → High Priest Zadok
nodes.role: Perpetual High Priestly Line of Zadok
nodes.notes: Aaron (+ Elisheba, sister of Judahite prince Nahshon!) -> Eleazar -> Phinehas -> Abishua -> Bukki -> Uzzi -> Zerahiah -> Meraioth -> Amariah -> Ahitub -> Zadok (David & Solomon's High Priest!).

nodes.name: Hilkiah → Seraiah → Jehozadak → High Priest Joshua → Jaddua & Ezra
nodes.era: Exile → Persian Period (1 Chr 6; Ezra 7; Neh 12)
nodes.notes: Seraiah -> Jehozadak -> High Priest Joshua (rebuilt Temple with Zerubbabel) -> Joiakim -> Eliashib -> Joiada -> Jonathan -> Jaddua (who greeted Alexander the Great in Josephus!) & Priest-Scribe Ezra (commissioned by Artaxerxes I!).

nodes.name: Zechariah & Elizabeth (Priestly Division of Abijah) → John the Baptist
nodes.notes: Descended from Aaron via Abijah; Elizabeth was a kinswoman of Mary, bridging the Levitical priestly line and the Davidic line of Jesus!

nodes.name: Prophet Elijah (Tishbite) & Prophet Elisha (son of Shaphat)
nodes.role: Prophets Opposing House of Ahab & Baal
nodes.notes: Elijah confronted Ahab & Jezebel on Mt. Carmel and ascended in a whirlwind; Elisha anointed Hazael of Syria and Jehu of Israel.

nodes.name: Prophet Isaiah (son of Amoz) & Prophet Zephaniah (Hezekiah's Line)
nodes.notes: Isaiah (+ sons Shear-jashub & Maher-shalal-hash-baz) counseled Kings Uzziah through Hezekiah; Zephaniah 1:1 traces Zephaniah (son of Cushi -> Gedaliah -> Amariah -> Hezekiah) directly to King Hezekiah!

nodes.name: Prophet Jeremiah (+ Scribe Baruch) & Prophet Ezekiel (son of Buzi)
nodes.notes: Priestly prophets witnessing the fall of Jerusalem (586 BCE) and exile to Babylon; Baruch (son of Neriah) preserved Jeremiah's scrolls.

nodes.name: Prophet Daniel (Belteshazzar), Shadrach/Meshach/Abednego & Nehemiah
nodes.notes: Daniel (royal Judean youth) & companions Hananiah, Mishael, Azariah served under Nebuchadnezzar, Cyrus, and Darius; Nehemiah (son of Hacaliah) served as cupbearer to Artaxerxes I at Susa before rebuilding Jerusalem's walls!

nodes.name: Hosea (+ Gomer), Amos, Jonah, Micah, Habakkuk & Zechariah
nodes.role: Prophets of Israel, Nineveh & Post-Exilic Judah
nodes.notes: Hosea (son of Beeri + Gomer -> Jezreel, Lo-ruhamah, Lo-ammi), Amos, Jonah (sent to Nineveh!), Micah, Habakkuk, and Zechariah (son of Berechiah son of Iddo).

nodes.name: Jair → Mordecai & Queen Esther (Hadassah) vs. Haman the Agagite
nodes.era: 5th c. BCE (Susa / Persia — Book of Esther)
nodes.role: Benjaminite Queen of Persia & Defeat of Amalekite Haman
nodes.notes: Benjamin -> Kish -> Shimei -> Jair -> Mordecai & cousin Hadassah (Queen Esther), wed to Persian Emperor Ahasuerus (Xerxes I), thwarting Haman son of Hammedatha the Agagite (descendant of Amalekite King Agag -> Esau's grandson Amalek!).

nodes.name: Abiud → Eliakim → Azor → Matthan → Jacob → Joseph (Matthew 1 Line)
nodes.role: Legal Royal Line from Solomon & Zerubbabel to Joseph
nodes.notes: Complete Matthew 1 genealogy: Zerubbabel -> Abiud -> Eliakim -> Azor -> Zadok -> Achim -> Eliud -> Eleazar -> Matthan -> Jacob -> Joseph (husband of Mary).

nodes.name: Nathan → Mattatha → Neri → Matthat → Heli → Mary (Luke 3 Line)
nodes.role: Luke 3 Davidic Line via Nathan to Mary
nodes.notes: Complete Luke 3 genealogy through David's son Nathan (via Mattatha, Melea, Eliakim, Jonam, Neri, Rhesa, Joanan, Matthat, Heli -> Mary, mother of Jesus!).

nodes.name: Jesus of Nazareth ('The Christ') & Siblings (James, Joses, Simon, Jude)
nodes.role: Culmination of Both Matthew 1 & Luke 3 Genealogies
nodes.notes: Born in Bethlehem of Mary (Luke 3 line) & legal son of Joseph (Matthew 1 line) during Caesar Augustus & Herod the Great; chart also notes brothers James (leader of Jerusalem church), Joseph/Joses, Simon, and Judas/Jude.

nodes.name: Apostle Paul (Saul of Tarsus — Tribe of Benjamin)
nodes.role: Benjaminite Pharisee & Apostle to the Mediterranean
nodes.notes: Born in Tarsus (Cilicia — cf. Cilix/Tarshish!) of the Tribe of Benjamin; carried the Judeo-Christian movement across Anatolia, Greece (Athens/Corinth), and Rome!

nodes.name: Antipater the Idumean → Herod the Great → Archelaus, Antipas & Philip
nodes.notes: Antipater of Idumea (Edom — Esau's land!) allied with Julius Caesar; his son Herod the Great rebuilt the Second Temple and fathered Archelaus, Herod Antipas (+ Herodias & Salome), and Herod Philip — bridging Edom directly into Imperial Rome and the Gospels!

nodes.name: Merodach-baladan → Nebuchadnezzar II → Evil-merodach (Neo-Babylon)
nodes.role: Conqueror of Jerusalem & Builder of Babylon's Ishtar Gate
nodes.notes: Nebuchadnezzar II besieged Jerusalem (597 & 586 BCE), exiled Jehoiachin and Daniel, and built the Hanging Gardens/Ishtar Gate; succeeded by Evil-merodach (Amel-Marduk) who released King Jehoiachin!

nodes.name: Tiglath-Pileser III (Pul) → Sennacherib → Esarhaddon → Ashurbanipal
nodes.role: Assyrian Emperors of the Biblical Books of Kings & Isaiah
nodes.notes: Tiglath-Pileser III (Pul) exacted tribute from Israel/Judah; Sennacherib besieged Hezekiah (Taylor Prism) before being slain by sons Adrammelech & Sharezer; Esarhaddon & Ashurbanipal (Osnappar) conquered Egypt (Taharqa)!

nodes.name: King Hiram of Tyre, King Mesha of Moab (Mesha Stele) & Hazael of Aram
nodes.role: Levantine Monarchs Attested in Bible & Inscriptions
nodes.notes: Hiram of Tyre supplied cedar & craftsman Huram-Abi for Solomon's Temple; King Mesha of Moab's 840 BCE Stele mentions Omri, Israel & 'House of David'; King Hazael of Damascus (Tel Dan Stele) fought Jehoram & Ahaziah!

nodes.name: Pharaoh Neco II (26th Saite Dynasty of Egypt)
nodes.role: Pharaoh at Battle of Megiddo (609 BCE) & Carchemish (605 BCE)
nodes.notes: Marched north to aid Assyria against Babylon, slaying King Josiah at Megiddo (609 BCE) and installing Jehoiakim; Herodotus credits Neco II with commissioning Phoenician sailors to circumnavigate Africa!
